description.name: mgo_on_fe
description.purpose: Ground-state comparison between the inverted stack (MgO film on an Fe substrate) and Fe-on-MgO (main text). Flatness is measured over the deposited film in each stack: Fe for femgo, MgO (Mg+O) for mgofe.

key_definitions.ground_state: the lowest-potential-energy structure over the completed searches
key_definitions.dZ_film: z(max)-z(min) over the deposited film (Mg+O for mgofe, Fe for femgo)
key_definitions.flat_relative_to_island_eV_per_atom: (E_flat_min - E_island_min)/N for the stack; negative means the flat film is the lower branch

description.convergence: The inverted-stack searches do not converge at the 100-iteration budget, so the comparison is indicative rather than settled. The per-run evidence behind that statement is kept here for traceability; the manuscript states it at the run-set level only.
description.scope_bound: Boron-free; bounds the structural result only.
description.run_selection: completed searches only (budget 100); a search that stopped at iteration 26 is excluded; scratch trash/ excluded; iteration >= 10

headline.conclusion: ground-state comparison: the inverted stack's ground state is a flat MgO film (dZ 0.39 A), the opposite of Fe-on-MgO whose ground state is an island (dZ 3.65 A); the inverted-stack searches do not converge at the 100-iteration budget, so the comparison is indicative rather than settled
